title: Sources: the FTC and 20+ state AGs plan to sue Amazon for allegedly making tens of billions over seven years by manipulating ad prices on its retail platform (Dave Michaels/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Dave Michaels / Wall Street Journal: Sources: the FTC and 20+ state AGs plan to sue Amazon for allegedly making tens of billions over seven years by manipulating ad prices on its retail platform — Commission and more than 20 states to allege e-commerce giant reaped billions by manipulating ad prices on its retail platform
contentText:
Dave Michaels / Wall Street Journal :

FTC to File Lawsuit Alleging Amazon Deceived Advertisers   —  Commission and more than 20 states to allege e-commerce giant reaped billions by manipulating ad prices on its retail platform  —  WASHINGTON—The Federal Trade Commission plans to file a lawsuit against Amazon.com on Monday alleging …
